statement: The proportion of SUID cases with hospital overnight stays after birth is higher compared to the weighted prevalence among live births in the general population.
rationale: This study uses a case-population comparison design to assess whether infants who had an overnight stay in the hospital after birth are more likely to experience sudden unexpected infant death (SUID).
prior_art: None in the inputs. The closest claims do not address postnatal hospital stays and their association with SUID incidence.
cannot_establish: Causation, as the design only allows for association due to potential confounding factors such as prematurity and maternal smoking.
